protocol_source: source-tree/004-paired-protocol-preregistration/tex/body.tex, section 'The paired experiment, fixed in advance', and tex/generated_table_protocol.tex
authorisation: Workspace owner granted full decision authority to the coordinating agent on 2026-09-07 for scientific strengthening of the six manuscripts; this run executes the protocol the manuscript itself pre-registered, on the same backbone and budget as the arms being re-tested (SD1.5, 500 steps). This is the F-01 unlock; it is recorded here rather than assumed.
background_prompts: on a city street at night

generation.pairing_unit: (concept, background_prompt, seed); the two arms are generated from the same seed-initialised latent

endpoints.primary: per-pair difference in identity fidelity (CLIP-I, openai/clip-vit-base-patch32): composed minus joint
secondary: Wilcoxon signed-rank on the same primary pairs

inference.primary_test: one pooled two-sided exact sign test across the 24 pairs at alpha = 0.05; ties (exact zero difference) are excluded from the sign test and counted
inference.decision_rule: if at least 18 of 24 non-tied pairs share a sign (<= 6 discordant pooled), the sign test is significant at alpha = 0.05; concept-level counts are reported descriptively and do not form a second confirmatory family
inference.effect_sizes: mean and median paired difference with 95% percentile bootstrap interval over pairs (B = 10000, fixed seed 20260907), reported regardless of outcome
